name: test_mixed_order.py
mathematical_scope: Checks finite-field mixed-order and reflected Green half-cut ranks and density at N=8,16,32,64; separately compares phase diagonals to explicit quadratic/linear powers.
input_and_guard_coverage: Only four positive power-of-two sizes; no invalid size, zero-pivot, noncanonical field or alternate root controls.
costs: Dense audit and inverse/rank dependencies dominate; this test file establishes no linear-time transform.
test_evidence: Two unittest methods; the exact-rank and recurrence equalities are useful independent expected values, but dependencies are resolved by bare module names.
acceptance_boundary: Finite regression checks of chosen controls, not a theorem for arbitrary mixed-order stages or an executed pass.
findings: L7–14 check four sizes; L19–23 compare all phase entries. Full dependency review is not supplied by these tests.
